name: Pipeliners - OTTO Homepage NLP Baseline 2026-08-20
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-20

# Summary
Rollback reference captured Aug 20, 2026, before cleaning up the OTTO NLP terms on the homepage. OTTO deletions cannot be undone and per-term restore is not in the API, so the folder must be kept.

# Key findings
- OTTO SEO score 79. Homepage NLP terms: 99 total, 98 deployed, 1 unapproved ("natural gas").
- Homepage GSC (90 days): 26 clicks (25 of them brand), 2,850 impressions, 9 queries with any click. Periods: Feb 19 to May 19 vs May 20 to Aug 18, US, URL-prefix property.
- KRT project 34164: 9 of 43 tracked keywords ranking; only "pipe lining phoenix" (position 15) points at the homepage.
- OTTO project snapshot: 4,664 items (3,837 approved, 827 pending) across title tags, metas, headings, image alts, schema, missing keywords, NLP terms, link building, dynamic indexing and social tags. Homepage target keywords: sewer pipe lining, pipeliners, epoxy pipe leak repair.

# Decisions and status
- Planned: keep 54 terms, remove 45 (19 tier 1 entity damage, 26 tier 2 DIY, materials or navigation). Wave 1 = 18 tier 1 terms.
- Re-run the GSC pull at +30 and +60 days with the same period lengths.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `01-otto-homepage-nlp-terms-99.csv`: the rollback list with KEEP/REMOVE tags.
- `02-gsc-homepage-queries-90d.csv`, `03-krt-rankings-snapshot.csv`, `04-otto-project-snapshot.md`, `README-BASELINE.md`.
